collection.source_basis: The prescription is a corpus file: it carries, per surface, the radius, the axial thickness, the refractive index, the Abbe number, the element outline and the stop plane. The corpus is MIT licensed and is what this record reproduces; the patent number the file cites is kept as the design's own reference and is not claimed as a transcription of that publication.

aperture_validity.basis: The imported stop plate reaches the clear aperture of the glass beside it, so it blocks light outside its opening.
aperture_validity.consequence: The record may be evaluated against stop-dependent constraints, but no field-resolved pupil or illumination evidence is claimed.

spectrum.sampling_wavelengths_basis: DERIVED: the corpus states its glasses by nd and vd, which define the helium d line and the hydrogen F and C lines; those three vacuum wavelengths are the Project's sampling set
spectrum.wavelength_precision: Vacuum nanometres, full precision, as the engine evaluates them.

continuous_coverage_nm.note: The corpus states no operating band; only the three sampling wavelengths exist.

image_format.basis: DERIVED: twice the largest image height the modelled field covers at the paraxial focal length under the stated projection. It is the field the prescription is evaluated over, not a tested image circle.
image_format.format_basis: SOURCE_STATED: the corpus pairs this design with an FX product; the derived field is the numerical check beside it

effective_focal_length_mm.conditions: Primary wavelength 587.5618 nm (vacuum), object at infinity.

total_track_mm.definition: First surface vertex to the image plane along the axis

engine_check.method: Thick-lens ABCD at the primary wavelength through the committed Project, composed from the members' poses

comparison.rule: per quantity: |engine - source| <= atol + rtol * scale
comparison.tolerance_basis: the corpus states the design focal length as 24.0 (3 significant digits), so half a unit in its last stated digit allows 2.08e-03; the record also carries the nearest published catalog glass for each stated nd/vd pair, whose index differs from the stated one, so the allowance is raised to 5.00e-03. A file beyond that is deferred rather than published with a focal length the engine does not reproduce

back_focal_length.note: the corpus file states no back focal distance, so there is nothing to compare it with

f_number.definition: Image-space f-number, the aperture ratio the product is sold at

stop_opening_diameter_mm.definition: Diameter of the declared iris opening in the native Project

field.basis_note: DERIVED: the FX diagonal (43.27 mm) at the design focal length

verification.basis: MATCHED when the chief ray of every declared field reaches the image plane at some sampling wavelength; the difference from the paraxial height is the lens's distortion, not a mismatch
verification.wavelength_aggregation: every sampling wavelength traced separately; each field's measured height is the mean of its chief-ray arrivals
verification.paraxial_reference: image height = EFL * tan(theta) for a rectilinear projection, EFL * theta for an equidistant fish eye

approximations.description: The corpus file states one outline per element and no clear aperture. the stop is sized for the stated f-number; every surface of one element shares one clear semi-diameter, the smaller of (the unvignetted aperture for the axial marginal ray plus the chief ray of the stated half field) and (the radius at which the steepest surface of that element has a sag of half the adjacent glass thickness), never below 1.02 x the marginal ray height

The corpus file states a refractive index and an Abbe number per surface and no glass name. Each pair is matched to the closest published catalog glass and the Project carries that glass's own dispersion curve; the differences are recorded in materials.model_glasses.

The prescription covers the FX format, so the modelled field is the angle the FX diagonal subtends at the design focal length: 84.0622 deg full field. It is the field the lens is sold to cover, not a field the corpus file states.

solids_findings.message: element LENS member L5: the SCHOTT_N-SF56 between S1 and S2 is 6.4 mm thick at its edge, 45% of its clear diameter 14.3 mm, above the review ratio 35%

evidence_notes: The corpus states the design focal length as 24.0 mm; the engine gives 23.951459 mm, a difference of 0.404 of the allowance.
The modelled field of 84.062 deg covers 43.18 mm of image at 23.951 mm.
